_meta._note: Wave 1C — HAL composite cost-controlled accuracy. HAL Princeton (ICLR 2026, 26,597 rollouts) does NOT publish a single composite score; each model's value here is the unweighted mean of its best per-benchmark accuracy across HAL's own 9 sub-leaderboards (cost-controlled by HAL's cost-aware evaluation harness). All inputs are sourced exclusively from hal.cs.princeton.edu sub-leaderboards — no external scores were synthesized. Models with full 9/9 coverage match the HAL paper's 9-model x 9-benchmark grid; partial-coverage models (Anthropic post-Sept-2025 releases tested only on subset) are flagged in their notes. HAL has paused leaderboard updates per the site banner.
